verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਸਭ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਕਵਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes sunio sunio sabh kouoo kahai kavan surat sun anat na dhaieeaai ||

en.bdb: Everyone claims to have listened to the Guru's sermon. But what is that unique voice, hearing which the mind does not wander away?

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਜਪਤ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਹ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jai jaikaar japat jagat gur ma(n)tr jeeh kavan jugat jotee jot liv laieeaai ||

en.bdb: The whole world praises the Guru's incantations and recite it too. But what is that mean which will attach the mind in the radiant Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਹੀਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੂੜ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥੫੪੧॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT surat giaan dhiaan saraba(n)g heen patit paavan gur mooR samajhaieeaai ||541||

en.bdb: A fool who is devoid of such limbs and appendages that provide him with knowledge of the True Guru and contemplation, True Guru-the maker of pious people out of sinners, bless them with such divine knowledge through Naam Simran.  (541)
